name: FormRef
title: reference boards for images, ideas and creative work
summary: FormRef is a free, open-source local reference workspace: collect images and files, arrange them on a free canvas, add notes and tasks, and connect ideas.
lede: FormRef is a local reference workspace in the Form family. Collect images and files, arrange them on a free canvas, add notes and tasks, connect ideas and organize boards, then export or control the same workspace through MCP. A Rust engine owns geometry, locking, grouping, arrangement and undo.
runs_on: In a browser on loopback, or as a Tauri desktop app for macOS, Linux and Windows (the packaged builds have not yet been run on every OS)
checks: Arranges images on a free canvas with crop, flip, grayscale, opacity, snapping, grouping and columns.
Adds study aids: Value Study, Drawing Grid, Extract Palette, Measure, Compare and timed Practice with a Practice Log.
Imports BeeRef .bee boards and iStack, and exports PNG, SVG, Markdown, JSON, PDF and a ZIP of every picture's original file.
Finds pictures by colour or by similarity, with saved searches and a tag cloud.

facts.dd: Rust document engine under a Python FastAPI media and persistence service
BeeRef .bee in and out, iStack import, PDF, Word, Markdown and text export

chapters.title: A free canvas for references
chapters.text: Collect images and files, crop nondestructively on the board, flip, set per-image grayscale and opacity, and pack or distribute spacing. Groups, columns, nested boards and board tabs keep large boards organised.

chapters.title: Tools for studying a picture
chapters.text: Value Study reduces a picture to 2 to 8 grey values, and Timed Practice shows pictures one at a time for gesture and figure drawing, from 30 seconds to 10 minutes each. Compare shows two pictures side by side, as an onion skin, with a swipe divider or as a difference.

chapters.title: An agent panel that asks before big changes
chapters.text: The Agent panel (Ctrl+J) runs Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or Ollama on your board, shows each tool call, and asks before removing or bulk-moving items. Stop and Undo This Turn takes the whole turn back.

features.title: One engine
features.text: Rust commands own geometry, locking, grouping, arrangement and undo/redo.
bullets: Menus, palette, shortcuts and agents share one command registry
list_commands, describe_command and run_command reach every command an agent may run

features.title: Study aids
features.text: Value Study, Drawing Grid, Extract Palette, Measure and Compare.
bullets: Value Study with 2 to 8 grey values, notan at 2
Measure (Shift+M) for lengths, angles and proportions
Compare (Alt+C): side by side, onion skin, swipe divider or difference
Timed Practice (Alt+T) with a Practice Log of every session

features.title: Reference media
features.text: Original assets are kept, with nondestructive editing on the board.
bullets: Crop on the board (C) and lasso crop, flip, per-image and canvas grayscale
Opacity controls and ordered reference presentation
Playable video and audio cards with In and Out points
YouTube, Vimeo, Spotify and SoundCloud players
GIF frames: pause, step, scrub and keep

features.title: Canvas workflow
features.text: Persistent grid preferences and snapping with shared-engine undo.
bullets: Explicit pack and distribution spacing
Sizes normalized across a selection or within each group
Drag items into columns, or lock a column against drops
Split boards: copy or move a selection to a new board

features.title: Connecting groups
features.text: Groups connect like single nodes with the connect tool (Shift+C).
bullets: Name Group and Collapse Group (Alt+G)
Connect Selected (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+L) chains the selection in reading order
Right-click a line for solid, dashed or dotted, arrowheads, route and colour

features.title: Find and organize
features.text: Find by colour, find similar and saved searches.
bullets: Find by colour dims everything except pictures that contain it
Find similar at three levels, including mirrored or greyscale copies
Tag cloud with counts; right-click a tag to select, rename, merge or remove
Pictures take 1 to 5 stars
Select Duplicate Images

features.title: Notes, tables and comments
features.text: Notes, tasks, tables with typed columns and formulas, and map cards.
bullets: Synced notes: linked copies that change together
Comment threads on any item, resolved or reopened
Google Maps and OpenStreetMap links as map cards
Export any document as PDF, Word, Markdown or text

features.title: Interoperability
features.text: Import and export in the formats other reference tools use.
bullets: iStack import and BeeRef .bee boards in and out
Portable archives and PNG, SVG, Markdown and JSON export
Full-resolution PDF export, including tiled at 100% across A4, Letter, A3 or Tabloid
A read-only phone viewer page
Every picture's original file in one ZIP

features.title: Background removal
features.text: FormCut's models (U2Net built in, Person, IS-Net, Auto and SAM 2.1 click to select) or a model-free plain-background cut.
bullets: The original is kept and restored any time

features.title: Vector tools
features.text: Optional and off by default (Preferences, Vector drawing tools).
bullets: Pen, Curvature, Pencil and Direct Selection with Live Corner widgets
Pathfinder, Offset Path and Outline Stroke
Linear and radial gradients with up to 16 stops
Smart Guides (Ctrl/Cmd+U)

features.title: Capture and cloud
features.text: A browser clipper and opt-in cloud storage.
bullets: Chrome and Firefox extension in clipper/ saves images, text, links and pages
Google Drive and Dropbox with your own app credentials, off until you connect
Drag, paste or fetch images and pages from the web

features.title: Agents and terminal
features.text: Embedded agent panel, chat and terminal dock.
bullets: Agent panel (Ctrl+J) running Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or Ollama
Chat tab (Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+J) with a memory and cost meter
Terminal dock with a Claude Code button (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+J)
Python MCP SDK stdio server; ./formref claude starts Claude Code with the same tools

features.title: Languages and shortcuts
features.text: The whole window in 26 languages, English by default.
bullets: Your own board text is never translated
Change any shortcut from the shortcut sheet (?)
Board tabs restore where you left them
Trash keeps deleted boards and items until you empty it

parity.summary: Of the 54 capabilities scored, FormRef is full on 51, partial on 1 and has nothing for 2, graded from its code at v0.37.2. PureRef and Milanote each document 38 of the 54 rows.

requirements: Rust 1.90+ and the Tauri prerequisites for a native desktop shell
CairoSVG's native Cairo/libffi prerequisites for SVG-to-PNG export
docs.agents: Outside agents are refused until you allow them in the Agent panel; .mcp.json, .cursor/mcp.json and .codex/config.toml run ./formref mcp, and the MCP server is also at http://127.0.0.1:8320/mcp.

topics.title: Quick Start
topics.text: The README gives requirements, commands for macOS, Linux and Windows (formref_oc_install.bat, formref.bat) and a table of the editor, backend, API docs and MCP addresses.

topics.title: MCP
topics.text: The README explains how the three client configs run the root launcher and how to set an absolute path or a Windows cmd command.

topics.title: Configuration
topics.text: Variables such as FORMREF_DATA_DIR, FORMREF_API_URL and FORMREF_MCP_IMPORT_DIR are listed in the README.

topics.title: Shortcuts
topics.text: Press ? for every shortcut; the right-click menu follows iStack's order and shortcuts.

topics.title: Command line
topics.text: ./formref open <board> and ./formref import <folder> work with the running app; ./formref i18n review and apply handle translation sheets.

topics.title: Wiki
topics.text: .docs/wiki holds usage, engine contract, shell, agent and release guides.

items: The Windows desktop app no longer opens to a blank window when the .js file type is set to text/plain
The Windows build links its C runtime statically, so it starts without the Visual C++ Redistributable
The Linux packages recommend the GStreamer plug-ins used for audio and video, and the AppImage carries them
FormRef installs as a desktop app on macOS, Linux and Windows, carrying its own engine
If the engine cannot start, the start-up screen says why and where its log is
build_app and build_app.bat make the installers on the computer they run on
The start-up screen's logo no longer jumps when the rest of the screen appears
A window smoke test fails on any layout shift, console error or failed request

shots_wanted.what: A board with many images arranged on the canvas
shots_wanted.how: Run ./formref, open http://localhost:5320, then import a folder of images with ./formref import <folder> or drag images onto the canvas.

shots_wanted.what: Value Study or Compare on a picture
shots_wanted.how: Select a picture and open Value Study from the Images menu or press Alt+C for Compare with two pictures selected.

shots_wanted.what: The Agent panel open beside a board
shots_wanted.how: Press Ctrl+J to open the Agent panel beside the board (the Chat tab is Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+J).

shots_wanted.what: Find by colour with a tag cloud visible
shots_wanted.how: Use the find box under the item count, pick a swatch colour and show the tag cloud beneath.
